# Programming-language standard — zephyr_idiolect

*Localization of existing standards (ISO/IEC 9899, 14882, IEEE 1800/1076, …) — not re-authorship.*

Script/locale: Private/idiolect · register: idiolect · (C) 1993–2026 Abhishek Choudhary, GPL.

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `while` | ⵣlo | `zephlo` | `while` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.5.1 |
| `for` | ⵣfo | `zephfo` | `for` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.5.3 |
| `return` | ⵣba | `zephba` | `return` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.6.4 |
| `int` | ⵣnu | `zephnu` | `int` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.7.2 |
| `void` | ⵣno | `zephno` | `void` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.7.2 |
| `printf` | ⵣsay | `zephsay` | `printf` | ISO/IEC 9899 §7.21.6.3 |

**Semantics are preserved**: each row maps a surface keyword onto the canonical construct; the execution target (GCC today, neuromorphic tomorrow) never sees the linguistic layer.
